title: (No AI) Firefox’s Smart Window promises a better AI browser
author: Stevie Bonifield
content:
![A screenshot of AI tab group suggestions in Firefox’s Smart Window](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Firefox_SmartWindow_OrganizeTabs.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Starting today, AI chats in Firefox's [Smart Window AI browsing mode](https://blog.mozilla.org/en/firefox/firefox-smart-window/) can pull from current web info and show source links in chat responses through a partnership with [Exa](https://exa.ai/). Smart Window can also now automatically suggest tab groups and show visual previews of pages you previously visited when you search your browsing history using natural language.

I saw a live demo that showed how the Smart Window AI could sort through selected links in your browsing history to pull up "running shoes I looked at last week," and pop up images pulled from the sites browsed previously. The suggested groups of tabs can also find and close duplicates, making it …

title: (No AI) Google’s Pet Memory forgot who my cats are
author: Jennifer Pattison Tuohy
content:
![Google Nest camera on a background of black and white cat fur.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/268628_Pet_week_CVirginia_PET_RECOGNITION.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

One of the best things my smart home does is [help me care for my pets](https://www.theverge.com/24074059/smart-home-pet-tech-tips-gadgets-solutions), and security cameras are particularly useful for keeping track of my many critters. But the barrage of notifications they send often means I miss important ones. So, when Google announced its new [Pet Memory feature for Gemini for Home](https://www.theverge.com/tech/942001/nest-cams-can-now-recognize-your-furry-friends), I thought this could be the perfect solution.

Pet Memory promises to teach your Google Home smart home who your pets are, allowing connected Nest cameras to go beyond simply telling you they saw an animal to _which_ animal they saw. It can then use that knowledge to adapt your smart home to your pet.

My plan was to use it to keep a digital …
